subject: general
question: Which is the largest inland saltwater lake in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **Sambhar Lake.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **Sambhar Lake**

__
 
• **India's largest inland salt lake is located in Sambhar Lake Town, Jaipur district of Rajasthan.**
 
• **It is ****80 km southwest of the city of Jaipur and 64 km northeast of Ajmer, Rajasthan.**
 
• It i**s famous for harbouring flamingos in large numbers.**
 
• **The lake receives water from six rivers: Mantha, Rupangarh, Khari, Khandela, Medtha and Samod. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**Devtal Lake

 
• **Devtal lake is a sacred lake atop Mana Pass.**
 
• It is **considered very holy since this lake is believed to be the origin of the Mythical Saraswati River. **

**Pushkar Lake**

 
• **Pushkar Sarovar is located in the town of Pushkar near Ajmer city in the Ajmer district of the Rajasthan state of western India**.
 
• It is a **sacred lake of the Hindus.**

**Lonar Lake**

 
• Also known as **Lonar crater.** 
 
• It is a **notified National Geo-heritage Monument, saline, soda lake, located at Lonar in Buldhana district, Maharashtra.**
 
• It was created by a **meteorite collision impact during the Pleistocene Epoch.**
